note: City of Freeman campground beside the swimming-pool park, with a playground and tennis courts. The bathhouse is open mid-May to mid-October, with shower water from Memorial Day weekend to October 1. Fires only in approved fireplaces or grills; no out-of-state firewood. --Claude
